seed_command: none (local-first, fully offline; no backend, no DB, no keys needed)
reset_command: clear browser storage (vault state lives client-side) and restart the dev server
cleanup: rm -rf .eva-tmp/incognito && clear browser profile/localStorage so the synthetic fixture vault is destroyed
prohibited_actions: CRITICAL: NO real passwords, SSNs, cards, accounts, API keys, or vault imports — synthetic fixtures only
never connect real provider API keys
never trigger real breach-check, broker-removal, or legal submissions

journeys.name: Vault gate loads and identifies Incognito (note: use http://localhost:5173 explicitly — Windows ::1 ordering quirk)
